## The three lines that are not obvious

**The Karn plus Liquimetal Coating land lock.** Karn's static clause is "Activated abilities of
artifacts your opponents control can't be activated." Liquimetal Coating's tap ability makes any
target permanent an artifact until end of turn. Point it at an opposing land and that land's mana
ability - an activated ability of an artifact they control - cannot be activated for the turn.
Repeat every untap, choosing whichever land makes the colour their answer needs. It is the only
answer in the 75 to an opposing land, and it is why boros ponza and dimir control are playable.
